title: Introduction to Architectural and Urban Systems Engineering
desc: Introduction of the major issues in the profession of architectural and urban systems engineering
note: Team teaching with Prof. Jun-Seong Yi

title: Capstone Design
desc: A project to propose creative ideas for element technology to be used in buildings and urban systems

title: Urban Disaster Risk Management and Public Safety
desc: A fundamental understanding of urban disaster risk management and public safety management for resilient urban systems

title: Introduction to Urban Infrastructure Systems
desc: Basic principles for successful management of urban infrastructure systems, including infrastructure planning, financing, engineering, construction, operation, and maintenance, with a consideration of physical, technical, economic, social, and environmental aspects of urban infrastructures as well as relevant policies and regulations

title: Building Information Modeling and Applications
desc: An overview of data and information Modeling in building and construction and practices of 3D-based modeling for generating and managing construction- or building-related data and information.

title: Research Design in Planning
desc: An understanding of research design and methodology in the field of urban planning

title: Urban Planning Theory
desc: Review and discussions on planning  theories within the context of the history of urban planning and their implications for practice

title: Dynamic Analysis of Architectural and Urban Systems
desc: A comprehensive exploration of current issues in the sustainable growth of cities through an in-depth understanding of interactions of urban sub-systems (e.g., economics, populations, politics, cultures, transportation, housing, land, etc.) and infrastructure systems using computer simulation and modeling techniques

title: Advanced Information and Communication Technologies for Smarter Cities
desc: A broad introduction to advanced data processing and analysis methods, with a focus on the use of machine learning techniques for managing urban data streams generated by ICTs.

title: Cyber Physical Social System for Smart Cities
desc: Understanding of the concept of cyber-physical-social system(CPSS) for smarter cities and technical aspects of CPSS such as simulation modeling, digital twin, and sensor-control mechanisms

title: Human-oriented Urban System Management
desc: A fundamental understanding of human factors associated with various people in an urban area, including their emotional, cognitive, physical, and behavioral characteristics, to devise strategies for better urban system and infrastructure management with a focus on human safety, health, and wellness.

title: Dynamic Construction Modeling & Simulation
desc: A fundamental understanding of the use of computer simulation in construction projects and urban infrastructure management

title: Architectural Engineering Capstone Design
desc: Full-scale studies of real value engineering (VE) projects

title: Building Information Modeling
desc: An overview of Building Information Modeling (BIM)

title: Project Management System
desc: Fundamentals of project-based organization, change management, resource management focusing primarily on human aspects, organizational behavior and culture, change and interface management, and performance (e.g., productivity, quality, and safety) improvement

title: Architectural and Urban Systems Computer Programming
desc: Introduction to computer applications in architectural and urban systems engineering and object-oriented programming
